verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe automatic extraction of memories from raw conversation/content (supermemory-docs-1), background-maintained user profiles built from interactions without explicit search (supermemory-docs-15, supermemory-docs-33), and a living knowledge graph consolidating facts over time (supermemory-docs-14), matching the self-deciding, background-consolidating memory story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating extraction quality or consolidation accuracy in practice (community evidence only covers unrelated ingestion-size and OAuth complaints), and no detail on how conflicting/duplicate facts are resolved during consolidation.
